app.name: CHATme
app.tagline: Work. Play. Stay Connected. Global with CHATme.

auth.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A longer phrase is stronger.
auth.usernameHint: Letters, numbers and underscores. Starts with a letter.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.linkSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.
auth.passwordUpdated: Your password was changed. Please sign in.

home.intro: Your account is ready. Set up your profile and preferences so CHATme works the way you like.
home.verifyBanner: Please confirm your email address. We sent a link to {email}.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Translations marked as draft are still being reviewed.
settings.performanceHint: Auto picks the best mode for this device and connection.
settings.whoCanAddToGroups: Who can add me to groups
settings.discoverable: Let people find me by username
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
settings.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes your account and signs out every device. It cannot be undone.

devices.title: Devices
devices.count: {count, plural, one {# active device} other {# active devices}}
devices.signedOutOthers: {count, plural, =0 {No other devices were signed in.} one {Signed out # device.} other {Signed out # devices.}}

network.offline: You're offline. You can keep reading; changes will sync when you reconnect.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.conflict_email: An account with this email already exists.
errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.csrf_failed: Your session could not be verified. Please reload the page.
errors.service_unavailable: CHATme is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side.
errors.network: Can't reach CHATme. Check your connection.

email.footer: You received this email because a CHATme account uses this address.
email.verifyBody: Hi {name}, tap the button below to confirm this email address for your CHATme account.
email.verifyIgnore: If you didn't create a CHATme account, you can ignore this email.
email.resetBody: Hi {name}, we received a request to reset your password. Tap the button below to choose a new one.
email.resetExpiry: This link expires in 1 hour and can be used once.
email.resetIgnore: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password won't change.
email.newSignInSubject: New sign-in to your CHATme account
email.newSignInBody: Hi {name}, your account was just signed in on {device}.
email.newSignInAction: If this wasn't you, reset your password right away and sign out other devices in Settings.
email.passwordChangedBody: Hi {name}, the password for your CHATme account was just changed and your other devices were signed out.
email.passwordChangedAction: If you didn't do this, reset your password immediately.
email.accountDeletedBody: Hi {name}, your CHATme account and its data have been permanently deleted. We're sorry to see you go.
